scripts.deploy:staging: npx eas-cli env:exec preview "EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-staging --clear" --non-interactive && npx eas-cli deploy --environment preview --export-dir dist-staging --alias staging --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:production: npx eas-cli env:exec production "EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist --clear" --non-interactive && npx eas-cli deploy --environment production --export-dir dist --prod --non-interactive
